author: nero_eth
content:
Wrt eip-8411 (fast broadcast) and eip-8146 (bal-sidecars):
8411 consumes most parts of 8146 (bal gets separated bc chunks are an even more granular separation already). The only thing missing is the **earlier BAL deadline**.
Imo, we should consider doing 8411 + an earlier BAL-chunks observation deadline (1s before the payload-chunks deadline.
This is grear for many reasons like UX, scaling (+20%), FOCIL includers, etc.
